loggedPrefix.meaning: Observed prefix only, including its final rejected state; no completed startup acceptance.

loggedDiagnostics.meaning: Logged diagnostics only. A step is printed before its guard; record counts are not accepted steps. No independent budget reconciliation, field validation or startup acceptance.
loggedDiagnostics.budgetLimitMeaning: Initial-inventory limits are evaluated only with one valid version-1 initial record.
loggedDiagnostics.legacyCounterMeaning: Top-level pairedStepRecordCount counts SC1_TWO_STEP only, not SC1_VOF_STEP.

initial.pressure: Hydrostatic continuum profile matching alpha; vent p_rgh=100000 Pa

provenance: Native processor internal fields mapped by cellProcAddressing; full global-cell permutation and mapped initial fields checked. No external build/control-chain revalidation.
meaning: Saved-output diagnostic only. Source startup failed. No CFD, reconstruction, restart, field edits or acceptance.
patchMeaning: Adjacent means owner of a boundary face, not distance to a wall.
stencilMeaning: Raw cell/neighbour values only; no discrete force balance or cause inferred.

verification.verificationMeaning: Archive and three included source files verified; initial hash entries agree with the pinned manifest. The native mesh/field arrays are not bundled, so their 185 input hashes are recorded HPC evidence, not independent local native-field verification. All four compact console snapshots agree with the full report; the 168-step budget was recomputed from the included log.
verification.inference: The pure-phase circumferential peaks, shifted neighbour columns and much slower interface/wall motion justify testing scalar gradient reconstruction. Cell-centre stencils are not a face-force budget and do not prove which term is responsible.
verification.nextAction: Nonorthogonal pressure convergence did not fix the rest failure. Use the passive two-step force decomposition in SC1_REACTOR_VOF_FORCE_PROBE_2026-11-11.md.
